data.one_liner: Automatically sync app theme with OS and persist user choice
data.what_it_does: EasyDynamicThemeWidget reads the system theme and applies it to your MaterialApp. It also lets you force light or dark mode and stores the preference with shared_preferences.
use_when: You want your app to follow the device theme automatically
You need to persist the user’s theme choice across launches
You want quick, out‑of‑the‑box widgets to toggle theme
avoid_when: You need fine‑grained control over multiple custom themes
You are building a complex state‑management solution that requires custom logic
weaknesses: Only supports light/dark, no custom theme switching
No integration with advanced state‑management libraries
Limited customization of the toggle widgets
